title: v0.5.0 features (ADO-team focus)
desiredOutcome: The pipeline plugs into the team's Azure DevOps workflow: bugs/tasks sync to work items, CI can gate on manifest state, status renders as a shareable report, and two sessions cannot corrupt one manifest.
summary: Shipped as six direct-to-main commits, tagged v0.5.0. All eight selftest suites green (163 cases); the dogfood gate and report smoke run in CI. The single open item is the manual live ADO round-trip on first team use — surfaced by P3.1's manual gate entry.

tasks.title: Azure DevOps work-item sync (/audit:sync push|pull|status)
tasks.description: Contract = az boards CLI (headless-capable in ADO Pipelines); MCP wit_* tools documented as an optional fast-path. Config meta.ado {organization, project, areaPath?, types}; bugs<->Bug and tasks<->Task mapping; additive write-back fields bug.ado/task.ado {id,url,lastSyncedAt}; push idempotent (diff before write), one direction per invocation, no background magic.

gate: manual: live push/pull round-trip against a scratch ADO project on first team use

outcome.technical: sync.md command (bbf99eb) + ado schema/validator fields (f4aa52a). Structural verification: schema fixtures, validator cases, claude plugin validate. The live ADO round-trip is deliberately a manual gate entry above.
outcome.descriptive: The manifest tracker now speaks the team's board language.

tasks.title: CI headless gate (scripts/audit-status.py --json|--gate)
tasks.description: Machine-readable phase/task/bug rollup; --gate exits 1 on open high-severity bugs / blocked tasks / invalid manifest (reuses validate-manifest as a library). Ship an azure-pipelines.yml example and wire into this repo's CI against this manifest.

add: 14 selftest cases incl. exit-code matrix and readiness rule

outcome.technical: audit-status.py (ef5464d); azure-pipelines.yml example + CI wiring landed in f14f462. Gate conditions: invalid, open-high-bugs, blocked-tasks (+open-bugs, in-progress via --fail-on).
outcome.descriptive: A pipeline can now block a merge on manifest state without any Claude session.

tasks.title: /audit report (scripts/render-report.py)
tasks.description: Manifest -> self-contained HTML + Markdown (phase progress, task table, bug rollup, ADO links from the ado fields); publishable as an ADO pipeline artifact. report subcommand runs it and prints the artifact path.

add: 13 selftest cases incl. XSS escaping and javascript: URL neutralization
CI report smoke on this manifest

outcome.technical: render-report.py (13cb4d4) + report subcommand in audit.md (ebc5d36). Inline CSS, zero network fetches, all manifest strings escaped, http(s)-only links.
outcome.descriptive: Status is now a shareable artifact, not a terminal scroll.

tasks.title: Concurrency lock (<manifestPath>.lock)
tasks.description: Acquire {hostname, startedAt} lock around mutating subcommands (next|run|phase|review|resume); refuse with holder info on conflict; stale >60min offers a confirmed takeover; status/report never lock; require-plan exempts the lockfile AND the manifest itself (fixes custom manifestPath outside exempt globs).

add: require-plan selftests a4-a6: custom-path manifest + lock allowed, sibling gated

outcome.technical: Lock protocol in audit.md; require-plan manifest/lock exemption (25 selftest cases). Lock protects the manifest; working tree/branches still favor one session per clone.
outcome.descriptive: Two sessions can no longer silently corrupt one manifest.
